title.purpose: Card titles and brand names on cards.

shadows.name: clay-sm
shadows.purpose: Chips, pills, small buttons, icon discs.

shadows.name: clay-btn
shadows.purpose: Grape filled buttons and selected chips.

shadows.name: clay-well
shadows.purpose: Inputs, fact tiles, quiet and empty states.

motion.name: ease-squish
motion.purpose: Bounce on hover (translateY -2px) and squish on tap (scale .96); user-requested, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one grape filled action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; background: #6E4BF5; color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 22px -12px rgb(84 58 200 / .75), inset -5px -7px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / .24), inset 5px 7px 12px rgb(255 255 255 / .35); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.45,1), background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5B39E6; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6E4BF5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Cream Button
components.css: .ds-btn-cream { font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; background: #FFF7F1; color: #2B2146; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 14px -9px rgb(84 58 200 / .4), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .1), inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .9); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.45,1); } .ds-btn-cream:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #fff; } .ds-btn-cream:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.96); } .ds-btn-cream:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6E4BF5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Single-select filter pill; selected is grape.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 10px; background: #FFF7F1; padding: 12px; border-radius: 32px; } .ds-chip { font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; border: 0; background: #FFE8DC; color: #2B2146; padding: 10px 16px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 14px -9px rgb(84 58 200 / .4), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .1), inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .9); transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.45,1); } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-chip-on { background: #6E4BF5; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 14px 22px -12px rgb(84 58 200 / .75), inset -5px -7px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / .24), inset 5px 7px 12px rgb(255 255 255 / .35); }

components.name: Brief Card
components.description: A pastel clay slab per brief; the brand name is the logo.
components.html:
Britannia

Food & FMCG · Macro creators

Looking for food, lifestyle, and comedy creators for the Good Day & Jim Jam social remix campaign.

View brief
components.css: .ds-brief { font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; background: #FFEFA3; color: #2B2146; padding: 24px; border-radius: 32px; max-width: 360px; box-shadow: 0 18px 30px -18px rgb(84 58 200 / .45), inset -7px -9px 16px rgb(43 33 70 / .12), inset 7px 9px 16px rgb(255 255 255 / .7); } .ds-brief h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-meta { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #574A78; } .ds-brief p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-view { display: block; margin-top: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: rgb(255 247 241 / .8); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 9px 14px -9px rgb(84 58 200 / .4), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .1), inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .9); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Pressed-in clay well with a grape focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; color: #2B2146; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFF7F1; color: #2B2146; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .12), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .85); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #574A78; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .12), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .85), 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 75 245 / .45); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Pitch status; same label and colour on creator and admin screens.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Baloo 2', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #2B2146; box-shadow: 0 9px 14px -9px rgb(84 58 200 / .4), inset -3px -4px 8px rgb(43 33 70 / .1), inset 3px 4px 8px rgb(255 255 255 / .9); } .ds-short { background: #DCD1FF; } .ds-pend { background: #FFEFA3; }

narrative.overview: Align's creator and admin surfaces are soft, puffy clay on a warm peach ground, lit from the top-left, with one grape colour for the action you came to take. Controls bounce on hover and squish on tap so creators on mid-range phones always know what is pressable. Brands appear as their names set big on pastel slabs, never as logo images.
keyCharacteristics: Peach ground, cream clay surfaces, five pastel clay fills
Grape is the only filled action colour
Depth from layered clay shadows; no borders
Bounce on hover, squish on tap, off under reduced motion

rules.name: The One Grape Rule
rules.body: Grape fills one action per view plus the current selection.

rules.name: The Same Words Rule
rules.body: A pitch status has one label and one colour on both creator and admin screens (lib/status.ts).

rules.name: The Name Is The Logo Rule
rules.body: Brands appear as their names set big; no logo images until real marks are supplied.

rules.name: The No Border Rule
rules.body: Clay surfaces never take a border; separation comes from shadow and fill.

dos: Do give each brief its colour through clayFillFor(slug).
Do keep one grape filled action per view and put the price on the charging button.
Do use lib/status.ts labels and colours on both sides.
Do keep phone tap targets at 44px or more.
donts: Don't put borders on clay surfaces.
Don't use peach clay for brief cards.
Don't show stock-photo logos or unearned verified badges.
Don't add a second action colour.
Don't use dark ink bands on creator or admin screens.
